description: This file declares utility functions, classes, and constants for bot behavior and navigation in the Unvanquished game, including targeting, movement, and skill management.

classes.name: botMoveDir_t
classes.description: Enumeration for bot movement directions with bit flags for forward, backward, left, and right.

methods.name: G_BlockingGenerateNavmesh
methods.description: Generates navigation mesh for specified classes.

methods.name: G_BotNavInit
methods.description: Initializes bot navigation system, optionally generating navigation data.

methods.name: G_BotNavCleanup
methods.description: Cleans up bot navigation resources.

methods.name: FindRouteToTarget
methods.description: Finds a route from the bot to a target, allowing partial routes.

methods.name: BotMoveToGoal
methods.description: Moves the bot towards its goal.

methods.name: BotMoveUpward
methods.description: Moves the bot upward towards a target position.

methods.name: BotWalk
methods.description: Enables or disables walking for the bot.

methods.name: BotSprint
methods.description: Enables or disables sprinting for the bot.

methods.name: BotJump
methods.description: Makes the bot perform a jump.

methods.name: BotStrafeDodge
methods.description: Performs a strafing dodge maneuver.

methods.name: BotAlternateStrafe
methods.description: Performs an alternate strafing movement.

methods.name: BotMoveInDir
methods.description: Moves the bot in a specified direction.

methods.name: BotStandStill
methods.description: Makes the bot stand still.

methods.name: BotWalkIfStaminaLow
methods.description: Commands the bot to walk if stamina is low.

methods.name: BotTraceForFloor
methods.description: Performs a trace to check for floor beneath the bot in a given direction.

methods.name: GoalInRange
methods.description: Checks if the goal is within a certain range.

methods.name: DistanceToGoal
methods.description: Calculates distance to the goal.

methods.name: DistanceToGoalSquared
methods.description: Calculates squared distance to the goal.

methods.name: DistanceToGoal2DSquared
methods.description: Calculates 2D squared distance to the goal.

methods.name: BotGetGoalRadius
methods.description: Retrieves the radius around the goal.

methods.name: BotFindRandomPointInRadius
methods.description: Finds a random point within a radius around an origin.

methods.name: BotPathIsWalkable
methods.description: Checks if a path to a target is walkable.
